Container.Name: proxyseerr
Container.Overview:
A lightweight API routing proxy that lets Seerr (or Overseerr/Jellyseerr) drive two Sonarr instances and two Radarr instances through a single server connection each - typically a standard English library and a dedicated Anime library set up per the TRaSH Guides.
Seerr can override a request's root folder and quality profile, but it cannot switch which instance a request is sent to. proxyseerr sits in between: it presents one merged API per service (both libraries, both root folders, both quality profiles), and routes each add, lookup, search command and queue call to the instance that actually owns it. Anime-side IDs are offset so the two instances never collide in Seerr's database.
Point Seerr's Sonarr server at port 5000 and its Radarr server at port 5001, pick the anime root folder or the [Anime] quality profile in a Seerr override rule, and the request lands on the anime instance. Configure only the Sonarr pair or only the Radarr pair if you only need one of them.
The proxy carries admin API keys for your servers, so it requires an API key of its own - generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24` and enter the same value in Seerr.

Config.Name: Sonarr Proxy Port
Config.Description: Port Seerr connects to for TV. Use this as the Sonarr port inside Seerr.

Config.Name: Radarr Proxy Port
Config.Description: Port Seerr connects to for movies. Use this as the Radarr port inside Seerr.

Config.Name: Proxy API Key
Config.Description: Required. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 24` and enter the same value as the API key for both servers in Seerr. The proxy holds your Sonarr/Radarr admin keys, so it will not start unauthenticated unless PROXY_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS is set.

Config.Name: English Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your standard TV Sonarr instance. This is the default instance: anything not matched as anime goes here. Leave all four Sonarr fields blank to run Radarr only.

Config.Name: English Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from the standard TV Sonarr (Settings - General - Security).

Config.Name: Anime Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your dedicated Anime Sonarr instance.

Config.Name: Anime Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from the Anime Sonarr instance.

Config.Name: English Radarr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your standard movie Radarr instance. Leave all four Radarr fields blank to run Sonarr only.

Config.Name: English Radarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from the standard movie Radarr instance.

Config.Name: Anime Radarr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your dedicated anime movie Radarr instance.

Config.Name: Anime Radarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from the anime movie Radarr instance.

Config.Name: Allow Anonymous
Config.Description: Set to true only if you deliberately want the proxy to accept any caller on your LAN without an API key. Leaving this false and setting a Proxy API Key is strongly preferred.

Config.Name: Anime Root Folder Match
Config.Description: Fallback keyword. If a request's root folder path contains this string and the path is not owned by a known instance, it is routed to the anime instance.

Config.Name: Anime Label Prefix
Config.Description: Prefix added to anime quality/language profile names so they are distinguishable in Seerr's dropdowns.

Config.Name: Anime ID Offset
Config.Description: Amount anime-side IDs are shifted by so the two instances share one ID space. Only change this before adding anything through the proxy - changing it later invalidates the IDs already stored in Seerr.

Config.Name: Upstream Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for an instance before giving up.

Config.Name: Request Log
Config.Description: errors = log every failed request (default), all = log every request including successful ones (useful while setting up), off = no access log. Routing decisions and every degraded path are logged regardless.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. INFO logs one line per routing decision.
